notes: R5-7 (CR 602.5, 605.1a). Faith's Fetters: 'its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.' Fetters enchants Animal Sanctuary. The {2},{T} counter ability is refused before anything is paid (the cat gets no counter, the {C}{C} stays in the pool). Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The {T}: Add {C} mana ability still works: the pool's {C}{C} and the Sanctuary's {C} pay Palladium Myr's {3}, and the Sanctuary taps. Fetters' enters trigger gains its controller 4 life.
